usedFor: Zoho Billing holds invoices, and “New Successful Payment” adds a row to Microsoft Excel through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Successful Payment” in Zoho Billing, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: It records each successful payment as a row, and you can set a lookback window.

watchOut: Zoho Billing triggers are polling, so “New Invoice” reaches Excel after a short delay.
